reviewItem.question: Does "The Cilium cluster name validation cannot be bypassed anymore, both for the local and remote clusters" mean a change to config-key:cilium|path=cluster-name (validation-tightened)?

proposed.statement: Cilium cluster name validation is now strictly enforced (max 32 lowercase alphanumeric characters or '-', starting and ending with an alphanumeric) for local and remote clusters and can no longer be bypassed.
